passages.text: Then David said, “Here shall be the house of the LORD God, as well as the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David spoke.
David said, “This place is the house of the LORD God.
This place is also the altar for burnt offerings for Israel.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד זֶ֣ה ה֔וּא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְזֶה־ מִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לְעֹלָ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: So David gave orders to gather the foreigners in the land of Israel, from whom he appointed stonecutters to prepare finished stones for building the house of God.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David wanted to build a house for God.
David gave an order.
He told people to gather all the foreigners living in the land of Israel.
David chose some of these foreigners to be stonecutters.
These stonecutters prepared finished stones.
They prepared these stones to build the house of God.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד לִכְנוֹס֙ אֶת־ הַגֵּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲמֵ֣ד חֹֽצְבִ֗ים לַחְצוֹב֙ אַבְנֵ֣י גָזִ֔ית לִבְנ֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: David provided a large quantity of iron to make the nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings, together with more bronze than could be weighed and more cedar logs than could be counted; for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought a large quantity of cedar logs to David.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David prepared materials to build the house of God.
David provided a large amount of iron.
David used the iron to make nails for the doors of the gateways.
David also used the iron for the fittings.
David provided so much bronze that no one could weigh it.
David also provided cedar logs.
There were so many cedar logs that no one could count them.
The Sidonians brought many cedar logs to David.
The Tyrians also brought many cedar logs to David.
passages.original: וּבַרְזֶ֣ל׀ לָ֠רֹב לַֽמִּסְמְרִ֞ים לְדַלְת֧וֹת הַשְּׁעָרִ֛ים וְלַֽמְחַבְּר֖וֹת הֵכִ֣ין דָּוִ֑יד וּנְחֹ֥שֶׁת לָרֹ֖ב אֵ֥ין מִשְׁקָֽל׃ וַעֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִ֖ים לְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּֽי הֵ֠בִיאוּ הַצִּֽידֹנִ֨ים וְהַצֹּרִ֜ים עֲצֵ֧י אֲרָזִ֛ים לָרֹ֖ב לְדָוִֽיד׃פ

passages.text: And David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent—famous and glorious throughout all lands. Therefore I must make preparations for it.” So David made lavish preparations before his death.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David had a son named Solomon.
David said, “My son Solomon is young.
Solomon does not have much experience.
The house we must build is for the LORD.
This house must be very great.
It must be famous everywhere.
It must be glorious in all lands.
I must prepare everything for this house.
So David made many preparations before he died.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִי֮ נַ֣עַר וָרָךְ֒ וְהַבַּ֜יִת לִבְנ֣וֹת לַיהוָ֗ה לְהַגְדִּ֨יל׀ לְמַ֜עְלָה לְשֵׁ֤ם וּלְתִפְאֶ֙רֶת֙ לְכָל־ הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אָכִ֥ינָה נָּ֖א ל֑וֹ וַיָּ֧כֶן דָּוִ֛יד לָרֹ֖ב לִפְנֵ֥י מוֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then David called for his son Solomon and instructed him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David had a son named Solomon.
David called for Solomon.
David gave Solomon a command.
David told Solomon to build a house.
The house was for the LORD.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֖א לִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֑וֹ וַיְצַוֵּ֙הוּ֙ לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: “My son,” said David to Solomon, “it was in my heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God, but this word of the LORD came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and waged great wars. You are not to build a house for My Name because you have shed so much blood on the ground before Me.
passages.sermon:
David spoke to his son Solomon.
David was the king of Israel.
David said, “My son, I wanted to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God.
This desire was in my heart.
But the word of the LORD came to me.
The LORD said, ‘You have shed much blood.
You have fought great wars.
You will not build a house for My Name.
You have shed much blood on the ground before Me.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר דָּוִ֖יד לִשְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנוֹ אֲנִי֙ הָיָ֣ה עִם־ לְבָבִ֔י לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃ וַיְהִ֨י עָלַ֤י דְּבַר־ יְהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר דָּ֤ם לָרֹב֙ שָׁפַ֔כְתָּ וּמִלְחָמ֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת עָשִׂ֑יתָ לֹֽא־ תִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֙יִת֙ לִשְׁמִ֔י כִּ֚י דָּמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים שָׁפַ֥כְתָּ אַ֖רְצָה לְפָנָֽי׃

passages.text: But a son will be born to you who will be a man of rest. I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side; for his name will be Solomon, and I will grant to Israel peace and quiet during his reign.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to David.
God said a son would be born to David.
This son would be a man of rest.
God would give this son rest from all his enemies around him.
This son's name would be Solomon.
God would give Israel peace during Solomon's life.
God would give Israel quietness in Solomon's days.
passages.original: הִנֵּה־ בֵ֞ן נוֹלָ֣ד לָ֗ךְ ה֤וּא יִהְיֶה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מְנוּחָ֔ה וַהֲנִח֥וֹתִי ל֛וֹ מִכָּל־ אוֹיְבָ֖יו מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּ֤י שְׁלֹמֹה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׁמ֔וֹ וְשָׁל֥וֹם וָשֶׁ֛קֶט אֶתֵּ֥ן עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּיָמָֽיו׃

passages.text: He is the one who will build a house for My Name. He will be My son, and I will be his Father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
passages.sermon:
Solomon is your son.
Solomon will build a house for My Name.
Solomon will be My son.
I will be his Father.
I will establish the throne of Solomon’s kingdom over Israel forever.
passages.original: הֽוּא־ יִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֙יִת֙ לִשְׁמִ֔י וְהוּא֙ יִהְיֶה־ לִּ֣י לְבֵ֔ן וַאֲנִי־ ל֖וֹ לְאָ֑ב וַהֲכִ֨ינוֹתִ֜י כִּסֵּ֧א מַלְכוּת֛וֹ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you, and may you succeed in building the house of the LORD your God, as He said you would.
passages.sermon:
David spoke to his son Solomon.
David wanted Solomon to build a house for the LORD God.
David said, “My son, may the LORD be with you.”
David prayed that Solomon would succeed.
David said, “May you build the house of the LORD your God.”
God promised that Solomon would build this house.
passages.original: עַתָּ֣ה בְנִ֔י יְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהִצְלַחְתָּ֗ וּבָנִ֙יתָ֙ בֵּ֚ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר עָלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Above all, may the LORD give you insight and understanding when He puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the Law of the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
You will lead Israel.
May the LORD give you insight.
May the LORD give you understanding.
He will command you over Israel.
He wants you to keep His Law.
The Law belongs to the LORD your God.
passages.original: אַ֣ךְ יִֽתֶּן־ לְּךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ שֵׂ֣כֶל וּבִינָ֔ה וִֽיצַוְּךָ֖ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלִשְׁמ֕וֹר אֶת־ תּוֹרַ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Then you will succeed, if you carefully follow the statutes and ordinances that the LORD commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses laws and commands for Israel.
You must obey these laws and commands.
If you obey them, you will succeed.
Be strong.
Be courageous.
Do not be afraid.
Do not be discouraged.
passages.original: אָ֣ז תַּצְלִ֔יחַ אִם־ תִּשְׁמ֗וֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָ֔ץ אַל־ תִּירָ֖א וְאַל־ תֵּחָֽת׃

passages.text: Now behold, I have taken great pains to provide for the house of the LORD—100,000 talents of gold, 1,000,000 talents of silver, and bronze and iron too great to be weighed. I have also provided timber and stone, and you may add to them.
passages.sermon:
David is speaking to Solomon, his son.
David is preparing for the building of the house of the LORD.
David says, “Look, I have worked hard to provide for the house of the LORD.
I have given 100,000 talents of gold.
I have given 1,000,000 talents of silver.
I have provided bronze and iron in such great amounts that no one can weigh them.
I have also given timber.
I have also given stone.
You may add more to these materials.”
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה בְעָנְיִ֜י הֲכִינ֣וֹתִי לְבֵית־ יְהוָ֗ה זָהָ֞ב כִּכָּרִ֤ים מֵֽאָה־ אֶ֙לֶף֙ וְכֶ֗סֶף אֶ֤לֶף אֲלָפִים֙ כִּכָּרִ֔ים וְלַנְּחֹ֤שֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶל֙ אֵ֣ין מִשְׁקָ֔ל כִּ֥י לָרֹ֖ב הָיָ֑ה וְעֵצִ֤ים וַאֲבָנִים֙ הֲכִינ֔וֹתִי וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם תּוֹסִֽיף׃

passages.text: You also have many workers: stonecutters, masons, carpenters, and men skilled in every kind of work— in gold and silver, bronze and iron—craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and may the LORD be with you.”
passages.sermon:
Solomon, you have many workers with you.
You have stonecutters.
You have masons.
You have carpenters.
You have men skilled in every kind of work.
You have craftsmen skilled in gold.
You have craftsmen skilled in silver.
You have craftsmen skilled in bronze.
You have craftsmen skilled in iron.
You have so many craftsmen that they cannot be counted.
Now, begin the work.
May the LORD be with you.
passages.original: וְעִמְּךָ֤ לָרֹב֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י מְלָאכָ֔ה חֹצְבִ֕ים וְחָרָשֵׁ֥י אֶ֖בֶן וָעֵ֑ץ וְכָל־ חָכָ֖ם בְּכָל־ מְלָאכָֽה׃ לַזָּהָ֥ב לַכֶּ֛סֶף וְלַנְּחֹ֥שֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶ֖ל אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר ק֣וּם וַעֲשֵׂ֔ה וִיהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon: “Is not the LORD your God with you, and has He not granted you rest on every side? For He has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land has been subdued before the LORD and His people.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David spoke to all the leaders of Israel.
David gave them a command.
He told them to help his son Solomon.
David said, “The LORD is your God.
The LORD is with you.
The LORD has given you rest on every side.
The LORD gave the people of the land into my hand.
The land has been subdued.
The land stands before the LORD.
The land stands before His people.”
passages.original: וַיְצַ֤ו דָּוִיד֙ לְכָל־ שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעְזֹ֖ר לִשְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃ הֲלֹ֨א יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵנִ֥יחַ לָכֶ֖ם מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּ֣י׀ נָתַ֣ן בְּיָדִ֗י אֵ֚ת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְלִפְנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Now set your heart and soul to seek the LORD your God. Get started building the sanctuary of the LORD God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy articles of God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
Set your heart to seek the LORD your God.
Set your soul to seek the LORD your God.
Begin building the sanctuary of the LORD God.
Build the sanctuary so you can bring in the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
Bring in the holy articles of God.
Place them in the temple that will be built for the Name of the LORD.
passages.original: עַתָּ֗ה תְּנ֤וּ לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְנַפְשְׁכֶ֔ם לִדְר֖וֹשׁ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְק֗וּמוּ וּבְנוּ֙ אֶת־ מִקְדַּשׁ֙ יְהוָ֣ה הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהָבִ֞יא אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֗ה וּכְלֵי֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לַבַּ֖יִת הַנִּבְנֶ֥ה לְשֵׁם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
